The Daily Brief documentation¶

Documentation for the Django news application built for the HyperionDev capstone. The pages below are generated directly from the docstrings written in the source files, so the code comments and this documentation can never disagree with each other.

Project layout¶

newsproject holds the Django project settings and root URL configuration. The news app contains everything else: the database models, the REST API serializers and viewsets, the server-rendered HTML views, and the admin and signal registrations.
